name: How long does it take to install new pool lights?
description: Installation time for new pool lights varies from a single day for simple upgrades to several days for complex projects involving new wiring or trenching.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new pool lights?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for installing new pool lights depends on the project's scope and complexity. For a straightforward installation of a few existing lights, it might take a single day. However, if new wiring needs to be laid, trenches dug, or if it's part of a larger pool renovation project, installation could extend over several days to a week. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project during the initial consultation.
